About Wood Castle
Nestled in the vibrant heart of New Delhi, Wood Castle stands as a beacon of sophisticated hospitality, thoughtfully designed to blend modern comfort with exceptional service. Our deluxe edifice has earned its reputation as a premier destination for discerning travelers from across the globe, from international tourists seeking authentic Indian hospitality to seasoned business professionals requiring a comfortable base in the capital.
Distinguished by our inclusion in the prestigious Lonely Planet travel guide, Wood Castle has established itself as a benchmark for premium hospitality in New Delhi.

Our Rooms
Deluxe Room
Step into the lap of luxury with our Deluxe Rooms, designed to offer you a comfortable and rejuvenating stay. These fully air-conditioned rooms come equipped with:
A plush king-sized bed (which can be split into twin beds upon request), topped with a 12-inch mattress and cozy comforter for ultimate relaxation.
A luxurious bathroom, thoughtfully designed with modern fixtures and premium amenities.
A wardrobe with a secure locker for your valuables, ensuring peace of mind during your stay.
An LED TV, perfect for unwinding with your favorite shows or movies.
4500/-
Book Your Room Now
Super Deluxe Rooms
For those seeking an even more indulgent experience, our Super Deluxe Rooms are a step above the ordinary. Spacious and thoughtfully designed to accommodate the guests, these rooms offer all the features of our Deluxe Rooms and more:
A king-sized bed that can be converted into twin beds for your convenience.
An enhanced layout with more space to relax and unwind.
Large windows that fill the room with natural light and provide better ventilation, creating a bright and airy atmosphere.
